title: Rust implementation with reviewed native allow-list
context: Implementation language for DS-CORE; scope options were server only, server plus tools, or everything; FFI options were allow-list, pure Rust, or crypto-only.
decision: Server engine and server-side tools (storage, Raft, GQL engine, CLI, bulk importer) are written in Rust. The Kubernetes operator and non-Rust drivers are excluded. Native C/C++ libraries may be linked only from a version-pinned, reviewed allow-list (candidates: RocksDB, aws-lc).
